blocking_issues.issue: e_n replacement with U(B,A) witness construction is required but very large refactor (~250-400 lines in a 4400-line file)
blocking_issues.root_cause: same_side lemma confirmed unprovable even with char_k: rank-r formula agreement cannot determine ordering relative to p_n because std_untl B sf_top is non-discriminating (holds on both sides when multiple B-points exist)
blocking_issues.resolution: Replace e_n construction in ghr93_case_II: remove forward-game e_n (lines 1241-1270), replace with U(B,A) witness extracted from rank-r tau formula transfer. Key prerequisite: Spoiler selections may need sorting (GHR93 assumes sorted a_0 < ... < a_n).

key_findings: char_k_depth (stavi_depth (char_k nf) + 2 <= r) is NECESSARY for rank-r tau transfer
stavi_truth_mu_at_point (GapDetection.lean:417) bridges truth and truth_mu at carrier points
rank-polymorphic char_k (∀ r', NormalForm sig r' 1 → StaviFormula) does NOT work: formula depth ~2r exceeds game rank r
k_nf-based char_k works: k_nf << r in completeness proof, so stavi_depth(char_k nf) + 2 ≤ r holds
same_side is fundamentally unprovable from rank-r type agreement alone — e_n replacement is the ONLY correct approach
